text: Residents have reached out to my office with concerns about pedestrian safety on Hutton Avenue and on surrounding neighbourhood streets. Our office has received a petition from residents in support of the installation of speed humps on Hutton Avenue. I am requesting that speed humps be installed on Hutton Avenue, between O’Connor Drive and Plains Road.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Authorized the installation of traffic calming (three speed humps) on Hutton Avenue, between O’Connor Drive and Plains Road, generally as shown in Attachment 1 to the letter (July 6, 2026) from Councillor Brad Bradford.
